1018: D is a dhampir, the half-breed child of a vampire father the legendary Vampire lord and human mother, therefore he makes the ideal vampire hunter.
1019: D's constant companion is his talking left hand, sometimes reffered to as the Countenanced Carbuncle. It is revealed that this is some sort of symbiotic entity which has taken up residence in D's hand, although why he has done so is not clear.
1020: Conspicuous as the sole woman of the group [The Marcus Brothers], although she isn't related by blood to the Marcus Brothers, they consider her their little sister. She fights using a very powerful gun.
1021: Meier Link is an extremely powerful "vampire knight" who is being hunted by both D and the Marcus Brothers for kidnapping Charlotte. Meier has the ability to change his long cape into steel with razor sharp edges, and his skill in using it matches D's skill with the sword.
1022: Charlotte Elbourne was the girl that was thought to be kidnapped by Meier. Later it is revealed that she and Meier were actually in love and were running away to be together. Charlotte wanted Meier to turn her into a vampire, but Meier refused to do so.
1023: Kyle Markus is a team member in a group of professional vampire hunters widely known as "The Marcus Brothers". The four Marcus brothers are all related except Leila, however they still treat her like a younger sister.
1025: A shroud-encased mutant with a warped sense of humor and a kabuki-like white face and hands. He crafts illusions and ensnares D with a dramatic time-space warping trap.
1026: The eldest of the Marcus Brothers and apparent leader, Borgoff carries a powerful wrist-mounted crossbow.
1027: Nolt Marcus is the tallest of the Marcus brother's, and has a white cross painted on his face with tubes going into the back of his head. His weapon is a large wooden hammer/stack. He will do anything for his brothers and hates the Barbaroi and the old guy.
1028: A much feared and little seen tribe of monsters and mutants. While all of them identify themselves as Barbarois- they are in fact a large confederation made up a wide range of creatures.
1029: A tall, curvaceous female demon covered in a brilliant layer of green fur (with gold streaks) over parts of her body that converges into a wild mane of similar hair.
1030: With long hair and Arabian-esque clothing, Mashira is a mutant werewolf. He can transform into his wolf form at will. He has very keen senses and hears sounds over great distances. He is probably the most loyal of the three- and is often the first to communicate with Meier.
17925: An ancient vampire who resides in the Castle of Chaythe, where Meier and Charlotte go in hopes that a still-functional ship can take them away from Earth.
38719: Charlotte's brother. Before having negotiations with D tried to save his sister himself, however, was wounded and lost nearly all his people. Also, he was the one who hired Marcus brothers in order to save Charlotte.
38720: "The Father" was an unidentified elder in Vishnu. He hired the Marcus Clan and Hunter D to rescue his daughter from Baron Mayerling. [Wikia] He is ready to pay $10 mln. (considered to be a very big sum) in order to save his daughter.
